inputs.attack_summary: float32 [batch, 64, 28], raw counts (the graph divides by 8)

outputs.wdl: [batch, 3] logits, order win, draw, loss for the side to move

notes: history_fens are newest first and exclude the position itself
tokens, attack_summary and legal_policy_index are in the model's frame (side to move as White); legal_uci is in the real frame
expected.policy_logits are raw logits at legal_policy_index; engine_policy is their softmax at temperature 1
expected.wdl_logits is the raw wdl output; expected.wdl and engine_wdl are its softmax
search uses softmax(logits / 2.0) as the prior; that is a search setting, not part of this fixture
